name: ganaderia-regenerativa
description: Aplicación web premium para gestión de ganadería regenerativa y rotación de potreros

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently 'cd apps/api && npm run dev' 'cd apps/web && npm run dev' 'cd packages/shared && npm run dev'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && npm run lint && cd ../web && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd apps/api && npm run format && cd ../web && npm run format
scripts.format:fix: cd apps/api && npm run format:fix && cd ../web && npm run format:fix && cd ../packages/shared && npm run format:fix
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
